<?php
trait T {
    public static function m() { echo "M;"; }
    public const Y = self::m(...);
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
trait U { use T; }
echo "PRE;";
class C { use U; public static $x = 1; }
echo "POST;";

<?php
trait T {
    public static function m() { echo "T;"; }
    public const Y = [self::m(...), E_STRICT][0];
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
set_error_handler(static function () { return true; });
class C {
    use T;
    public static $x = self::Y;
    public static function m() { echo "C;"; }
}
$f = C::Y;
$f();

<?php
trait T {
    public static function m($v = 7) {
        static $n = 0;
        echo "T:", self::class, ":", static::class, ":", $v, ":", ++$n, ";";
    }
    public const Y = self::m(...);
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
trait U { use T; }
register_shutdown_function(static function () {
    echo "SHUT;";
    class E {
        use U;
        public static $x = self::Y;
        public static function m() { echo "FRESH;"; }
    }
    $f = E::Y;
    $f();
    $g = clone $f;
    $g();
    E::m();
});
echo "PRE;";
class C { use U; public static $x = 0; }
echo "POST;";

<?php
function argument() { echo "ARG;"; }
trait T {
    abstract public static function n();
    public static function m() {
        echo "BODY:", self::class, ":", static::class, ";";
        new self(argument());
        echo "AFTER;";
    }
    public const Y = self::m(...);
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
trait U { use T; }
register_shutdown_function(static function () {
    echo "SHUT;";
    class E {
        use U;
        public static $x = self::Y;
        public static function n() {}
        public static function m() { echo "FRESH;"; }
    }
    $f = E::Y;
    try { $f(); }
    catch (Error $ex) { echo "ERROR:", $ex->getMessage(), ";"; }
    E::m();
});
echo "PRE;";
class C { use U; public static $x = self::Y; }
echo "POST;";
